title: SIDESTORY: ATO OPEN
lines: 01 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: ATO OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Ato event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, Soudanshitsu Mikage, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 [District of Eternal Neon]
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2 [Remnants of Kajimachi]
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 16:00 - February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 3 [Stairway to Severance]
DURATION: January 30, 2026, 16:00 - February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Soudanshitsu Mikage]
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Idle Gossip by clearing event stages. Idle Gossip can be spent running the Business for rewards.
REWARDS: Shokujidokoro Mikage Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Mitsukue Guidebook]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Mitsukue Guidebook] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★ ★ : Matsukiri], Shokujidokoro Mikage Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken, etc.
[Vintage Bazaar]
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken by clearing event stages and completing [Mitsukue Guidebook]. Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken can be used to redeem items from [Vintage Bazaar].

REWARDS: Matsukiri's Tokens, Shokujidokoro Mikage Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, EPOQUE Collection - Fantastic Crafts for Astesia, EPOQUE Collection - Letters from Wessex for Melantha, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
Note:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – HANABI EXILED
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Limited Headhunting [Hanabi Exiled], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate: ★★★★★★: Hoshiguma the Breacher [Limited] / Haruka ★★★★★★: Pepe [Limited] / Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska [Limited] / Gavial the Invincible [Limited]
★★★★★: Kichisei

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Hoshiguma the Breacher after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting]. Future [Limited Headhunting - Festival] and [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] will apply the same rule: players will get the current limited Operator after a total of 300 rolls (once only). This count does not carry over across [Limited Headhunting] banners.
Note:
- [Hanabi Exiled] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Haruka and Kichisei will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after January 30, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator Ch'en the Holungday will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for Ch'en the Holungday will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contracts): Hoshiguma the Breacher / Haruka / Pepe / Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska / Gavial the Invincible
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contracts): Ch'en the Holungday
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contracts): Kichisei
- Hoshiguma the Breacher is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting].
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim the reward on the event page: Ballad of Vagabonds Headhunting Permit * 1

Note: - Ballad of Vagabonds Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Hanabi Exiled] Limited Headhunting. - Ballad of Vagabonds Headhunting Permit expires at: January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [ HANABI EXILED ] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Hanabi Exiled] Limited Headhunting.
Note:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Hoshiguma the Breacher [Limited]
★★★★★★: Haruka
★★★★★: Kichisei
★★★★★: Matsukiri
Note:
- Operator Matsukiri is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Ato, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Hoshiguma the Breacher, Haruka, Kichisei, and Matsukiri will gain more Trust in the event stages during January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7).
06 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIAL EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - March 2, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim Top Operator Activity Transfer Permit * 1 (can be used to select one 6★ operator from Saria, Bagpipe, Eyjafjalla, or Surtr) and Outfit Voucher * 1 (can be exchanged for an Outfit currently being sold at the Outfit Store that matches the exchange conditions).
07 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] OPERATOR SAVAGE FOR A LIMITED-TIME CLAIM
DETAILS: After the event begins, [★★★★★: Savage] * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail.
Mail will be sent on: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
Available for claim: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Mail will be sent to: All the players who logged in and created a character before January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
Note:
Players who already have Operator Savage will obtain Savage's Token * 1 from this email, which can be used to improve the Potential of Savage.
08 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SENIOR OPERATOR TRANSFER PERMIT FREE TO CLAIM FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, Senior Operator Transfer Permit * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail. Players can use this permit to redeem one of the 5-star Operators within range.
All possible Operators: a 5-star Operator from a past Headhunting Pool up to and including 'Like Ending Like Death.' (Excluding Collaboration Operators and Recruit-only Operators)
Mail will be sent on: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
Available for claim: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Mail will be sent to: All the players who logged in and created a character before January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
09 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] TRACES OF TIME SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, etc.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Plaque - Pickled Cherry * 1
Day 4: Chip Catalyst * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Tactical Battle Record * 20, 'Her Beloved Machine' Furniture * 1
Day 6: Orundum * 200, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 8: LMD * 30000, Data Supplement Stick * 10
Day 9: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Note:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
10 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] ENMUSUBI WISHING WALL OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - January 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets after daily login. Consume trials to participate in [Enmusubi Wishing Wall]. The Wishing Tickets with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain the following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated; players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
11 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HD79 for Ch'en the Holungday
Misaligned Sightseer Collection - Nuit of the Nightsky for Pepe
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA161 for Necrass
MARTHE Sports Line - Boundless Sail for Thorns the Lodestar
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA054 for May
12 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - A Picnic Before A Long Trip for Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska
EPOQUE Collection - To Rest in Night Breezes for Poncirus
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Ten Thousand Mountains for Ch'en the Holungday
Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HD26 for Gavial the Invincible
Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HDm74 for Minimalist
13 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] RHODES FASHION REVIEW OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including: 0011 Tempest Series - Hear the Wind Sing for Fartooth, Test Collection Series - There They Be for Saga, and more.
14 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW FURNITURE SETS - HIGASHI SUMMER MANSION & SHOKUJIDOKORO MIKAGE
DETAILS: Brand new sets of themed Furniture, Higashi Summer Mansion and Shokujidokoro Mikage will be available.
Higashi Summer Mansion
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Limited-time sale at the Store: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Shokujidokoro Mikage
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Ato event rewards (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
15 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] ORIGINIUM FIRST-TIME PURCHASE RESET
RESET TIME: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Resets all players' Originium first-time purchase bonus. After reset, players can get double Originium for the first-time purchase again.

17 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] RECRUIT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruit.
★★★★★★ Passenger
★★★★★ Toddifons
Note:
During the update, tags that have not yet been used for Recruit will be refreshed. Please stay tuned for further information.
18 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET – XIANG YUAN DINER
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed furniture - Xiang Yuan Diner
HOW TO OBTAIN: Main Theme stages (excluding Challenge Mode and Tutorial) Lucky Drop, Supplies stages Lucky Drop.

DETAILS: New 'Xiang Yuan Diner' themed furniture will replace the existing Lucky Drop 'Rhodes Island Laundry' themed furniture. The 'Rhodes Island Laundry' themed furniture will be available in the Furniture Store.
'Rhodes Island Laundry' will be available from: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
19 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIALIZED MODULES UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Specialized Modules will be available, effective in certain game modes.
Operators with Specialized Modules in the current update:
★★★★★★: Swire the Elegant Wit (This Specialized Module can take effect in [Integrated Strategies])
★★★★★★: Pepe (This Specialized Module can take effect in [Reclamation Algorithm])
Note:
There are no unlock missions for Specialized Modules, and the materials needed for unlocking and upgrading them are significantly reduced compared to regular modules.
20 [6TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] THEMED BACKGROUND RE-EDITION
DURATION: January 16, 2026, 08:00 - February 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in to unlock the Background - Celebration. The Background can be viewed and used in Themed Background.
Please stay tuned for more information!
